coverage_gaps.scope: This HiSilicon aarch64 server / Ascend910_93 A3
coverage_gaps.conclusion: No same-machine Qwen measurements. Other Arm/mobile/Xeon/910B results cannot be scaled into local throughput.
Selected public data do not establish fixed logical B128/B512 throughput or actual MM batch shapes. Service request counts, QPS and llama-bench -b do not fill this gap.

Model support and Qwen recipes found, but no sufficiently specified absolute Qwen training-throughput row in these inspected sources. MindSpeed v2.2 README speed/MFU rows concern Llama/Mixtral, not Qwen.
No sufficiently specified absolute throughput row located in this finite survey. Training support is not a throughput measurement.
Unsloth publishes relative speed/VRAM claims and B2/GA4/rank32, but lacks a complete absolute tokens/s + sequence/hardware tuple; do not convert a 2x claim into throughput.
Public speed reports are not local numerical, task-quality or restart acceptance. None supplied the core-5 complete-return contract.

analytic_parameter_formula: vocab*h + layers*(h*head_dim*(2*attention_heads+2*kv_heads) + 3*h*intermediate + 2*h + extra) + h; tied input/output embedding counted once; Qwen2 extra=head_dim*(attention_heads+2*kv_heads) for QKV biases; Qwen3 extra=2*head_dim for Q/K norms
